classification.description: Who may be answered from this source. For a text-file: public and internal ground any answer; confidential grounds only a verified team member (never a customer or caller); restricted is not served by the built-in store at all because it has no document-level permissions.

file.description: text-file only: path, relative to this resource, of the `.txt` or `.md` business-rules file.

status.description: text-file only: only `approved` content can ground answers; absent means draft.

version.description: text-file only: version of the rules, cited with answers.

effectiveDate.description: text-file only: the content is not used before this date.

reviewBy.description: text-file only: the last day the content may ground answers. After it the source is stale and is not used until the owner reviews it and sets a later date. Omitted means it never goes stale.

locale.description: text-file only: the language of the content, such as en or en-SG. A kb.search that asks for one language skips sources labelled with another; an unlabelled source matches every request.

audiences.description: text-file only: Agents allowed to ground answers on this source; omitted means every Agent that selects it.
